name: com.irisvalet.android.apps.mobilevalethelper.database.contentproviders.DataContentProvider
description: On app startup, the iRiS Guest Library opens a private local store for property content, organized by property, language, version, and content type. The provider lets guest features read, save, update, or remove these cached values.
disableEffect: Guest pages that depend on this local content store may fail to load or show outdated property information.
